chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated said: Abu Ishaq (whose nickname was Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'r) narrated said: Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi al-Sayrafi narrated to me, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the nine signs that were given to Moses (peace be upon him). He said: The locusts, the lice, the frogs, the blood, the flood, the sea, the stone, the staff, and his hand.
ai.seo_question: What are the nine miracles granted to Prophet Moses according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) explicitly identifies the nine specific signs (ayat) bestowed upon Prophet Moses (peace be upon him) to confront Pharaoh, distinguishing them as distinct divine interventions. This list aligns with the Quranic narrative but provides a precise enumeration valued in Shia exegesis for understanding the scope of divine power over nature and the human body. The inclusion of the 'shining hand' and 'stone' alongside natural plagues highlights the multifaceted nature of these miracles as both physical phenomena and spiritual proofs.
